svg.title: Spatial Dynamic Compression pipeline diagram
svg.desc: Full native SVG reconstruction. The left frame contains, from top to bottom, an LLM bar, a colored token strip, a Spatial Dynamic Compression bar connected to an enlarged right panel, a Token Allocation wavy curve, Frame Group Fusion token grouping with arrows, MLP and VIT bars, and a bottom strip of video thumbnails. The right rounded frame is a magnified token-selection illustration: a gridded image with highlighted tokens, a small selected-token table, and three vertical action blocks Unique Select, Neighbor Fuse, and Drop with guide arrows. The layout is organized by horizontal symmetry on the left stack and a zoom-panel relationship on the right.
